title: Zeus authorizes the counterattack
intro: Zeus authorizes intervention. The goddesses descend to Troy and find Diomedes' men standing firm.

notes.text: νεμεσίζομαι, feel indignation: 2sg pres mid; + dat Ἄρῃ, “at Ares,” and acc τάδε ἔργα, “for these deeds.”
“How numerous … how fine a [host]”; quantity then quality, both with λαόν.
μάψ, recklessly / wantonly; “not in due order,” without proper restraint.
ἄχος, grief (neut); ἕκηλος, at ease / untroubled: nom pl with Aphrodite and Apollo.
τέρπομαι, take pleasure: 3pl pres mid. Κύπρις, Cyprian goddess, Aphrodite.
ἀνίημι, let loose: aor act ptc nom pl; Ares is its object, τοῦτον.
θέμις, established right / rule: epic acc sg; “knows no law.”
χολόω, anger: epic reduplicated fut mid, 2sg -εαι; “will you be angry with me?”
“If I strike … and drive him away”; πλήσσω perf act ptc nom fem sg; ἀποδίομαι, drive away: 1sg pres mid subj; ἐκ μάχης, out of battle.
Grievously / cruelly; adv. from λυγρός, painful / disastrous.
ἀπαμείβομαι, answer: pres mid ptc nom sg.
“Come now, indeed”; ἐπόρνυμι, rouse / set upon: 2sg aor imperative; οἱ = upon him, Ares.
ἀγελείη, Athena's epithet, traditionally “driver of spoil”; interpretation disputed.
ἔθω, be accustomed: 3sg perf act + inf. πελάζω, bring near / visit with; κακῇς ὀδύνῃσι, grievous pains (dat pl).
μαστίζω, whip: 3sg aor. ἀέκων, unwilling: nom dual; litotes, “willingly.”
πέτομαι, fly: unaugmented 3dual aor mid; subject the two horses.
μεσσηγύς, between, + gen; ἀστερόεις, starry: gen masc sg with οὐρανοῦ.
“As far as [a man sees] into the haze”; ἠεροειδής, misty: acc neut sg expressing extent.
σκοπιή, lookout / height: dat sg. λεύσσω, gaze: pres ptc. οἶνοψ, wine-dark: acc sg with sea.
ἐπιθρῴσκω, leap forward: 3pl pres. ὑψηχής, loud-neighing: nom pl. τόσσον answers ὅσσον: a whole horizon in one stride.
ἱκνέομαι / ἵκω, arrive: unaugmented 3pl aor. ποταμώ + ῥέοντε: acc dual, “the two flowing rivers.”
ἧχι, where. ῥοή, stream: acc pl. συμβάλλω, bring together: 3dual pres act; Simois and Scamander mingle their waters.
ἵστημι transitive 3sg aor, “halted [the horses].” λύω aor ptc nom fem sg, “unyoking”; ὄχεα, chariot.
ἀήρ, mist: acc sg; πουλύς = πολύς. χέω, pour: epic 3sg aor; concealing mist around the horses.
ἀμβροσίη, ambrosia, divine food. ἀνατέλλω transitive 3sg aor, “made grow”; νέμω pres mid inf, “to graze on.”
βαίνω unaugmented 3dual root aor, “the two went.” τρήρων, timid / tremulous; πέλεια / πελειάς, dove: dat pl.
ἴθματα, steps / gait: acc of respect; “like [doves] in their movement,” not necessarily transformed into birds.
ἀλέξω, defend: epic pres act inf; μέμονα, be eager: perf act ptc nom fem pl. ἀνδράσιν dat, the men they help.
ἵστημι, 3pl plup act, “stood.” “The might of Diomedes,” heroic periphrasis for Diomedes himself.
εἴλω, crowd together: aor mid/pass ptc nom pl. λείουσιν, epic dat pl of λέων, lion; ὠμοφάγος, raw-flesh-eating.
σῦς, pig: dat pl; κάπρος, wild boar. ἀλαπαδνός, feeble; οὐκ ἀλαπαδνόν, “no feeble strength.”
ἵστημι root aor ptc nom fem sg; ἀΰω, shout: 3sg aor. Her assumed voice follows next page.
